race.comment: OUTPOST (11) was beaten narrowly two runs back over this distance at Bordertown. Dropped back to 1100m at this track last start and was less effective. Very fit and can bounce back to winning form over his preferred trip. TRANTORO (10) went to Morphettville Parks last time out and wasn't disgraced in better company, beaten just over two lengths at the end of 1400m. Has won three from six here at this distance so this veteran mare comes right under notice. THEBIGSOSSO (1) returns from a 135-day spell that followed a poor campaign in the Autumn. Placed at four of five first-up runs so he should be ready to put in a big run. BRAZEN QUEEN (8) broke her maiden at Mt Gambier last time out. In the mix despite the step up in class.
